research_rationale: Read the embedded official original, held actor contexts, own terms, chain, conflicts and missing notices. Corrected the inventory using exact original-source spans. No machine search is accepted while the material current-law conflict remains unresolved. EO14173 section 3(a)(ii) hereby revokes EO13583 on 2025-01-21; the complete held actor context contains no postponement. This is a direct revocation candidate and not a conclusion that every original clause first ended then. Original section 2(b)(i) requires plan updates at least every four years; section 2(d) regular reporting and section 3 ongoing implementation/integration survive the first 90/120-day submission dates. These deadlines do not sunset the duties. Original section 4 preserves existing agency and EEOC authority, including independent diversity offices, and conditions implementation on law/appropriations. It does not by itself establish that EO13583 remains operative after express revocation. Relevant EO14035/EO14100 provisions are absent. The current-law lead for 5 CFR part 250 names EO13583 and section 2(b)(ii), but an authority citation cannot establish a continuing legal predicate without the operative regulatory text.
